summary: Player-name/profile file bootstrap. Allocates a directory-iterator object, builds a profile filename against the settings directory (dword_5EC440, falling back to byte_5EA438), and scans for existing profile entries. If an entry is found, the directory base and entry name are formatted into a path buffer and the file is copied into the settings directory via StringCopyFileCheckDispatch. If no entry is found, a default 'PlayerNameNever...' text file is read, the function recurses on the same object to create the default profile, and two flag bytes at this+0x49A8 and this+0x49A9 are set to 1. The iterator list is torn down before returning the copy/recursion result.
